No official annotations, actor IDs, stems, reference implementation, or held-out labels were available or consulted. Read-only evidence collection used three audio-evidence requests covering 0–20, 20–40 and 40–60 seconds. These supplied actual-W-channel faster-whisper base.en ASR, uncertain YAMNet AudioSet predictions (0.96 s windows / 0.48 s stride), and raw FOA active-intensity directions in 0.5-second windows. Audio evidence reported W-signal SHA256 `8c781d2c6d38847ca3f2f08970a8d82edd189c5c974ba8e37ae6366ced0cc890`. I did not directly hear the audio through the gateway; acoustic observations below are observations of these shared perception-tool outputs, not a claim of human audition. Visual evidence: supplied panoramas at 1, 20 and 40 s; additional full frames at 6, 12, 26, 33, 46, 54 s, then 14, 17 and 23 s. Twelve frames total. The application uses the real video, not those reference images. ## Observation versus inference ### Speech (strong class evidence; approximate boundaries) ASR gives a coherent conversation about travel, departure, getting water, studies and finding work. YAMNet strongly favors speech through approximately 0–12 s, 23–26 s, 28–36 s, 38–50 s and 55–60 s, with shorter / quieter turns in between.
